about_the_game:
Desktop Fisher - The Ultimate "Slacking Off" Fishing Experience!

This is a casual idle fishing game designed especially for office workers! During your busy workday, secretly open the game window, cast your line, and enjoy a moment of peace and the joy of catching fish. The game runs discreetly at the bottom of your desktop, letting you "look like you're working, but actually be fishing"—the true digital art of slacking off!

✨ Game Features

✅ Real "Desktop Fishing" – The game runs in a minimalist window mode, can be hidden in the taskbar, Your boss will never know!

✅ Cyber Fish Ecosystem – Collect unique digital fish from the virtual ocean and become the ultimate cyber angler!

✅ Customizable Desktop Aquarium – Decorate your virtual fish tank with your catches and create your own cyber aquatic paradise.

🖥️ Perfect For:

✔ Office workers & students – Anyone who needs a secret escape during work or study

✔ Fishing game lovers – A stress-free, relaxing fishing experience

✔ Pixel art & idle game fans – Enjoy collecting and progression at your own pace

🎣 Start your "paid fishing" adventure today!

(Disclaimer: The game is fun, but don’t get caught by your boss!~)
